card.name: Partway through drug and number strings
card.fires_on: Responds partway through a longer term in a drug label, such as inside a drug or enzyme name, a split-up number, or the space after 'vs.' before a number. The next piece is expected to continue the same term.

modes.label: Inside drug or enzyme names
modes.description: Middle piece of a split drug, enzyme or medical term.

modes.label: Inside numbers and statistics
modes.description: A digit or space within a result such as a confidence interval or survival comparison.

modes.label: Word before lab term
modes.description: The word 'estimated' or a split piece before a lab measure.
modes.example: interpreting changes in<< estimated>> creatinine clearance

card.plain: It fires in the middle of a long drug name or a number, when the term is not yet finished.
